sources.supports: Alibaba's current official page places one regional price tier through 256K input tokens; this does not establish what the tier threshold was during the earlier period or match the reported USD prices.

notes: The current Alibaba model page uses a 256K threshold, consistent with the corrected threshold, but the available primary source is not a historical capture and lists different region-specific prices. Internet Archive requests did not return a usable snapshot, so the evidence does not determine whether 128K was once official or when any provider-side change took effect.
